title: Spotify for Artists Save-to-Stream Ratio
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:streaming track_name=* saved_after_stream=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(saved_after_stream="yes",1,0))) as matched by track_name
| eval a_save_after_streaming_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_save_after_streaming_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Spotify listener sessions that end with a save after streaming by track.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which track are helping or hurting Spotify listener sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a save after streaming` on `music:streaming` events and summarize the hit rate by `track_name`.
visualization: Table of track with percentage of Spotify listener sessions ending with a save after streaming.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often a save after streaming happens for each track so you can see where Spotify listener sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
